name: Rock Paper Scissors
summary: Two players, public hands of rock/paper/scissors cards, ten rounds, scored by card.
rules_text: Two players each hold a public hand of rock, paper and scissors cards. Every round both talk, then play one card face down at the same moment. Rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, paper beats rock. A win scores the value of the winning card: rock one, paper two, scissors three. After ten rounds the higher score wins.
